title: Event Metric1 Rolling 7-Day Value Average
dataSources: Planning tasks (`event:task`), budget lines (`event:budget`), RSVPs (`event:rsvp`), vendor bookings (`event:vendor`), countdown milestones (`event:countdown`).
app: Wedding and event planning — task and budget spreadsheets, RSVP platforms (Zola, The Knot), vendor contracts, and seating tools — streamed to Splunk HEC via CSV exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=event:metric1 value=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(value) as daily_avg by _time
| streamstats window=7 avg(daily_avg) as rolling_7d
| sort _time
description: Tracks a seven-day rolling average of daily value for event metric1 (1) data.
value: Rolling averages highlight gradual drift without overreacting to one-off days.
implementation: Compute daily average `value` then a seven-day rolling mean for event metric1 (1) events.
visualization: Line chart of daily and rolling average value.
grandmaExplanation: It catches the smoothed week-long trend in your value from event metric1 (1).
